Implementation notes for the verifier: (1) LOG GOLDENS REGENERATED — DecisionLogRow gained the ratified doc-05 §2 field `typedSecret: Boolean = false` (the schema table already carried it; the code did not yet). With DECISION_LOG_JSON encodeDefaults=true every row encoding gains "typedSecret": false, so the seven Gate-5.1 goldens were regenerated via UPDATE_GOLDENS=true (the exact path the 8C/8J schema amendments used; every golden's diff is the one appended field) and the new row-typed-secret.json golden pins the populated shape (TYPE + EXECUTED + H8 gate event). Tier A artifacts did NOT change. (2) CREDENTIAL CARDS ALWAYS ASK — vision 06 §2a makes the card the secret's ONLY lawful source; a per-task-trust execution has no card, hence no lawful TextSource, so NavigationLoop presents the card for EVERY credential-typing action (H3/H4/H8 on TYPE) and feeds each resolution through the TaskGate's legal transitions (REQUEST→ASK→APPROVE/DENY/TIMEOUT, or REQUEST→EXECUTE(trusted) when trust already covers (class,site) — the row then logs APPROVED/trustedFromTask=true per §2). A DENIED/TIMEOUT on a trusted credential card (no pending request exists) skips the action locally and logs {class, DENIED/TIMEOUT, trustedFromTask=false}; the TaskGate records no refusal (nothing was pending), so the double-refusal abort applies to the untrusted path exactly as before (proven by test). This is the §2a-specific law governing where the secret comes from; §2 trust mechanics themselves are untouched for every non-typing action. (3) The masked-input card is the DebugGatePresenter only (harness stand-in); the phase doc scopes the product card form to Phase 9 — the GateCard.credentialTyping flag + ApproveWithSecret resolution are the seams Phase 9 reuses. An empty masked input resolves DENY (fail-safe: nothing was supplied). (4) Classification input on the credential path: GateAction.textToType still carries the stub phrase at CLASSIFY time (the classifier matrix and existing loop behavior unchanged — the classifier keys credential classes on field context, and the H1 card-shape guard runs on the classification input); the stub phrase NEVER executes on the credential path (proven by 8F.1's test asserting the phrase string never reaches enterText). (5) The run-report redaction pass scrubs cardSecrets from stepLog/partialResult at finish() (doc 05 §2 render law) — silent by design THERE (the loud seam is the state-text builder, per the phase doc); construction already keeps the value out of every line, the pass guards the page-echo edge case in partialResult.
